answer: Use stake-weighted quorum caps per funding source. Each account's attestation counts only up to a limit set by how many distinct wallets funded it. Wallets tracing to one root count as one island of influence. A 1,000-puppet farm funded from one root gets the weight of a single voter, so swaying a vote needs about 1,000 separately sourced wallets, each with a 25-token stake. Saffron-priced fakes earn no nectar.
